sample.body:
We are thrilled to announce a major new strategic partnership with the University of Bath, one of the UK’s top universities. This collaboration opens a significant new opportunity for agents to recruit high quality international students for September 2026 and beyond.


What’s new?

Starting in 2026, Study Group will deliver all degree preparation and English language programmes through a brand new on-campus International Study Centre at the University of Bath. The programme offering will include:

  • International Foundation Year programmes
  • Pre-Master’s programmes
  • Pre-sessional and In-sessional English programmes

This is a chance for students to begin their UK academic journey right on the University of Bath campus, giving them early access to facilities, support services, and the university community from day one.


Why Bath is a brilliant choice for international students

  • A stunning UNESCO World Heritage city that’s safe, welcoming and far more affordable than London.
  • Compact, walkable and well connected, with rapid links to Bristol, Cardiff, London and major airports.
  • A vibrant global food, culture and social scene, from museums and theatres to international shops and cafés.
  • A thriving international community, with almost 6,000 students from 152 nationalities.


Why this partnership matters for your recruitment

The University of Bath offers exceptional appeal to international students:

  • UK Top 10 university in all national rankings
  • 132nd globally (QS 2026) – strong recognition worldwide
  • Sport University of the Year (The Times and The Sunday Times Good University Guide 2026)
  • Renowned for graduate employability, industry placements, and career ready education
  • Triple TEF Gold—top level for teaching, outcomes, and experience
  • A safe, vibrant, student friendly campus with an international outlook

These strengths make Bath an attractive choice for students aiming for world‑class outcomes.


What this means for your pipeline

This partnership provides a major opportunity to grow recruitment into a prestigious university. You can now confidently guide more students towards Bath with guaranteed, structured routes to both undergraduate and postgraduate study.

With Study Group’s education expertise and Bath’s global reputation, this new International Study Centre will give students a strong foundation to succeed academically, integrate fully, and thrive in their future careers.


Get ready for September 2026!

More programme details, entry requirements, and marketing materials will follow soon and will be shared in our detailed training sessions open to all. 

Please register now for one of the two sessions noted below:

Training session 1 – Wednesday 18th March 10:00AM (UK Time) Register here

Training session 2 – Wednesday 18th March 04:00PM (UK Time) Register here

We are looking forward to supporting you and your students when applications open for September 2026.

sample.body:
Bellerbys Global gains momentum

January marked a meaningful moment for Bellerbys Global, bringing agents from multiple markets together in China for a series of activities focused on connection, clarity and first-hand understanding of how the programme is delivered across different locations.

From a grand celebration event in Beijing to on-campus visits in Xi’an and Shanghai, the programme offered agents the opportunity to engage more deeply with the Bellerbys Global model, its academic foundations, and the environments in which students study, thrive and progress.


Beijing Celebration (14 January)

The Beijing event brought together education agents, delivery partners and sector stakeholders to reflect on the continued development of Bellerbys Global and the role it plays within today’s evolving international education landscape.

Presentations from the Study Group leadership team explored how student decision-making is evolving, and how Bellerbys Global has been designed to respond to student needs through top-quality academic delivery, flexibility of starting location and transparent progression routes. The discussion emphasised clarity, trust and long-term partnership with agents as essential to supporting the success of students and families in an increasingly complex environment.

The event also included perspectives on international collaboration and education exchange, situating Bellerbys Global within a broader global and regional context.


Visit to Bellerbys Xi’an Study Centre –  delivered by Xi’an Eurasia University (15 January)

Following the Beijing celebration, a group of agents travelled to Xi’an to visit the Bellerbys Xi’an Study Centre, delivered by Xi’an Eurasia University.

The visit went beyond presentations and provided time on campus to tour facilities, observe a live demonstration class, and engage with the on-site academic and student support teams. This allowed agents to experience the learning environment first-hand and gain insight into how academic standards, teaching delivery and student support operate in practice, to nurture students academically and build their confidence.

Discussions also explored how international students adapt to life in Xi’an, how the city’s historical and cultural context enriches the student experience, and how a global programme is delivered within a high-quality local university setting.


Visit to the Bellerbys Shanghai Study Centre – delivered by East China University of Science and Technology (16 January)

Agents also had the opportunity to visit the Bellerbys Shanghai Study Centre, delivered by East China University of Science and Technology.

The visit included a campus tour and insightful sharing from Study Group’s Chief Executive Officer, Ian Crichton, alongside members of the university’s leadership team and academic faculty. These sessions covered the institution’s history, academic strengths and ongoing campus development.

While this Study Centre is still progressing through internal approval processes, the visit provided helpful academic and institutional context, enabling agents to better understand the delivery environment and its long-term potential for students who wish to start closer to home.


Marketing resources available

To support follow-up conversations with students and families, the following resources are now available on the Agent Portal:

  1. Bellerbys Global – Programme Overview and Study Centre Introduction
    An overview of the Bellerbys Global programme model, academic approach and progression framework, alongside introductions to the Study Centres currently open to international student recruitment:
    • Bellerbys Xi’an Study Centre – delivered by Xi’an Eurasia University
    • Bellerbys London and Eastbourne Study Centres – delivered by Twin
    • Bellerbys Singapore Study Centre – delivered by Victoria World Academy
  2. Bellerbys Global – Study Centres Factsheet
    A concise reference outlining Study Centre locations, delivery partners and current international recruitment availability.


Thank you

Thank you to all agents who joined us in Beijing, Xi’an and Shanghai. Your engagement, questions and on-the-ground feedback are valued and play an important role in shaping how Bellerbys Global continues to develop.

If you have any follow-up questions, please contact your Study Group sales representative.
sample.summary: A recap of the Bellerbys Global’s celebration in Beijing, agent visits to Study Centres in Xi’an and Shanghai, and marketing assets available.
